title: Version-clash audit: same build now enforced on every device, browser and platform
notes: Every page now carries a 2k2-version meta stamp so the app can detect when a device is running an OLD shell (stale service-worker cache, back/forward-cache restore, or a pinning tab) — and force-reload it onto the current build instead of serving old markup or the old onboarding again
Back/forward-cache restores and service-worker controller changes now trigger a one-shot reload so every device reconciles to the same released version
Verified live that all portals, sw.js and version.json deliver 2.3.19 / cache epoch 2k2-v21 on every platform and browser
